description: Retrieves the current state of a managed agent session. See [managing sessions](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions/manage).

401.description: Authentication or project context was missing.

403.description: The API key lacks the required permission.

404.description: The requested session or event was not found.

409.description: The request conflicted with the current session state.

agent.description: The agent running in the session.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the session was created.

environment.description: The execution environment for the session.

error.description: The error that caused the session to fail, if any.

last_active_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the session was last active.

metadata.description: Custom string key-value pairs attached to the session.

prompt_cache_options.description: Default prompt cache lifetime for turns in this session, when configured.

required_actions.description: Actions that must be completed before the session can continue.

review.description: Review applied to eligible actions in this session. Omitted when review is none and automatic review is not enabled. Omission means none.

status.description: The current status of the session.

usage.description: Best-effort token usage for the session, or null if unknown. Recorded usage may change.

vault_ids.description: The IDs of vaults made available to the session.

error.description: The error returned by the API.

SessionAgentResource.description: The effective agent configuration for a session.

experimental.description: The effective experimental settings for the agent.

instructions.description: Custom instructions appended to the agent's default base instructions.

model.description: The model used by the agent.

multi_agent.description: Configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

name.description: The reusable agent's name when the session was created, or null if no name was saved. Later changes to the agent's name do not affect this value.

service_tier.description: The effective service-tier policy for model requests. Defaults to `auto`.

text.description: Configuration for text generated by the agent.

EnvironmentResource.description: The execution environment for a session.

SessionRequiredActionResource.description: An action that must be completed before a session can continue.

SessionStatusResource.description: The current status of a session.

TokenUsageResource.description: Recorded token usage for a session or turn. Usage is best effort and may change.

input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens used by the agent.

input_tokens_details.description: A breakdown of the agent's input token usage.

output_tokens.description: The number of output tokens generated by the agent.

output_tokens_details.description: A breakdown of the agent's output token usage.

total_tokens.description: The total number of input and output tokens used by the agent.

param.description: The request parameter that caused the error, or null for a request-wide error.

type.description: The error type.

CompactionResource.description: The effective settings for compacting the agent's context.

async.description: Whether context is compacted in the background. Defaults to true.

ExperimentalConfigResource.description: The effective experimental settings for an agent.

time_awareness.description: Whether the model receives periodic current-time reminders.

MultiAgentConfigResource.description: The resolved configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

enabled.description: Whether subagent tools are enabled. Defaults to false.

max_concurrent_subagents.description: Maximum number of subagents that may run concurrently, or null when disabled. Defaults to 6 when enabled.

ReasoningResource.description: The reasoning configuration used by an agent.

effort.description: The requested reasoning effort, or `null` when the model selects its own default.

summary.description: The requested reasoning summary format, or `null` when summaries are disabled.

ServiceTierResource.description: The service-tier policy configured for an agent.

TextResource.description: The text configuration used by an agent.

format.description: The effective output format. Defaults to ordinary text.

verbosity.description: The amount of text produced by the agent. Defaults to `medium`.

AgentToolResource.description: A tool available to the agent.

EnvironmentResourceNone.description: The session talks to CCA without selecting or provisioning an execution environment.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `none`.

capability_directories.description: Directories that contain capabilities exposed to the agent.

container_size.description: The effective CPU and memory tier, or null when unknown or outside the public tiers.

files.description: Files available in the environment, excluding their contents.

id.description: The public ID of the environment.

network.description: The effective network access policy for the environment.

plugins.description: Plugins installed in the environment, excluding their archive contents.

skills.description: Skills installed in the environment, excluding their archive contents.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `openai_hosted`.

EnvironmentResourceSelfHosted.description: An environment hosted by the application.

capability_directories.description: Directories that contain capabilities exposed to the agent.

id.description: The public ID of the environment.

remote_url.description: Pass this URL unchanged to `codex exec-server --remote` when connecting this environment.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `self_hosted`.

workspace_directory.description: The absolute project directory inside the environment. Defaults to `/workspace`.

request.description: The information needed to render the request.

request_id.description: The registered request ID to echo when responding.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `computer_use_approval_request`.

SessionRequiredActionResourceFunctionCal.description: Run a function tool and submit its result.

arguments.description: The arguments supplied by the model.

call_id.description: The ID to include when submitting the function result.

turn_id.description: The ID of the turn that requested the function call.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `function_call`.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to reconnect.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `environment_connection`.

InputTokensDetailsResource-2.description: A breakdown of input token usage for a session or turn.

cached_tokens.description: The number of input tokens retrieved from the prompt cache.

OutputTokensDetailsResource-2.description: A breakdown of output token usage for a session or turn.

reasoning_tokens.description: The number of output tokens used for reasoning.

ReasoningEffortResource.description: The amount of reasoning effort used by an agent.

ReasoningSummaryResource.description: The reasoning summary format requested from an agent.

TextFormatResource.description: The effective output format for generated text.

VerbosityResource.description: The amount of text produced by an agent.

AgentToolResourceFunction.description: A function defined by the application.

async.description: Whether the agent continues without waiting for the function result.

defer_loading.description: Whether the function is deferred and discovered through tool search.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema object describing the function's arguments.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `function`.

AgentToolResourceProgrammaticToolCalling.description: Enables calling tools from model-generated code.

enabled.description: Whether tools can be called from model-generated code.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `programmatic_tool_calling`.

AgentToolResourceMcp.description: Tools provided by a remote MCP server.

allowed_tools.description: The MCP tools the agent may call.

connection_origin.description: Where outbound MCP HTTP connections originate.

credential_id.description: The attached vault credential selected for this MCP server, if any. Optional when exactly one attached credential matches the server URL.

request_metadata.description: Metadata included with requests to this MCP server.

required.description: Whether this MCP server must initialize before the first turn.

server_label.description: A label used to identify the MCP server in tool calls.

transport.description: The transport used to connect to the MCP server.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `mcp`.

allowed_domains.description: Allowed search domains, or `null` when the search is unrestricted.

context_size.description: The amount of search context made available to the model. Defaults to `medium`.

location.description: Approximate location used to localize search results, if provided.

mode.description: The source used for web search results.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `web_search`.

AgentToolResourceComputerUse.description: Browser use in an OpenAI-hosted session.

include_screenshots.description: Whether computer tool outputs include screenshots.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `computer_use`.

AgentToolResourceAutomations.description: Lets the agent manage its own scheduled wakeups.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `automations`.

ContainerSizeResource.description: The effective CPU and memory tier of an OpenAI-hosted environment.

DesktopResource.description: The effective desktop configuration for an OpenAI-hosted environment.

enabled.description: Whether the environment provisions a desktop and browser proxy.

HostedEnvironmentFileResource.description: Metadata for a file materialized in an OpenAI-hosted execution environment.

NetworkPolicyResource.description: Network access for an OpenAI-hosted environment.

allowed_domains.description: Domains the environment may access when network access is restricted.

EnvironmentPackagesResource.description: Packages installed in an OpenAI-hosted environment.

npm.description: npm packages installed globally in the environment.

python.description: Python packages installed in the environment.

system.description: System packages installed in the environment.

HostedPluginResource.description: A plugin installed in an OpenAI-hosted environment.

HostedSkillResource.description: A skill installed in an OpenAI-hosted environment.

TextFormatResourceText.description: Generates ordinary text without a structured-output constraint.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `text`.

TextFormatResourceJsonSchema.description: Constrains generated text to a JSON Schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema that generated text must match.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `json_schema`.

McpConnectionOriginResource.description: Where outbound MCP HTTP connections originate.

McpTransportResource.description: The transport used to connect to an MCP server.

WebSearchContextSizeResource.description: The amount of web search context made available to the model.

WebSearchLocationResource.description: Approximate user location used to localize web search results.

country.description: The two-letter ISO country code, such as `US`.

WebSearchModeResource.description: The source used for web search results.

HostedEnvironmentFileResourceFileId.description: A file copied from the OpenAI Files API.

file_id.description: The ID of the uploaded file.

id.description: The session-scoped ID of the file in the execution environment.

path.description: The file's absolute path inside the environment.

size_bytes.description: The decoded file size in bytes.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `file_id`.

HostedEnvironmentFileResourceInline.description: A file supplied inline when the session was created.

id.description: The session-scoped ID of the file in the execution environment.

path.description: The file's absolute path inside the environment.

size_bytes.description: The decoded file size in bytes.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `inline`.

NetworkAccessResource.description: The network access mode for an OpenAI-hosted environment.

HostedPluginResourceInline.description: A plugin installed from an inline ZIP archive.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `inline`.

HostedSkillResourceSkillReference.description: A skill installed from the Skills API.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `skill_reference`.

version.description: The concrete skill version installed for this session.

HostedSkillResourceInline.description: A skill installed from an inline ZIP archive.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `inline`.

ComputerUseApprovalRequestKindResourceBr.description: A registered form awaiting the application's response.

credential_origin.description: The registered form or frame origin where values will be entered.

fields.description: Controls to render. All submitted values are sensitive.

options.description: Sign-in methods. Empty for a plain form.

reason.description: Why the agent needs the user to sign in.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `browser_authentication`.

ComputerUseApprovalRequestKindResourceBr.description: A browser origin awaiting the application's approval decision.

origin.description: The origin the browser needs permission to access.

reason.description: The browser's explanation for this request, or null when unavailable.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `browser_origin_access`.

McpTransportResourceHttp.description: Connects to an MCP server over HTTP.

server_url.description: The URL of the MCP server.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `http`.

McpTransportResourceStdio.description: Starts an MCP server as a local process.

args.description: Arguments passed to the MCP server command.

command.description: The command used to start the MCP server.

cwd.description: The working directory used to start the MCP server.

env_vars.description: Environment variable names inherited from the execution environment.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `stdio`.

BrowserAuthenticationFieldResource.description: A control in a registered browser-login form.

id.description: The field ID to submit as field_id in a fields entry.

label.description: The label to display beside the control.

required.description: Whether this control requires a nonempty value.

type.description: The rendering type, such as email, password, or text.

BrowserAuthenticationOptionResource.description: A sign-in method and the fields that belong to it.

field_ids.description: IDs from the registered fields that this method accepts.

id.description: The option ID to submit as selected_option.
